environment: Development container, 4 vCPU, LiveKit 1.12.0 binary on 127.0.0.1, headless Chromium (software H.264/VP8 encoding), all browsers and the SFU on one machine
caveat: TEST-GENERATED high-entropy canvas video, not PS5 gameplay. The broadcaster's encoder was starved (qualityLimitationReason=bandwidth at 0.3-0.5 Mbit/s, very low frame rate), so client bitrates are NOT representative of a real PC; only the SFU's CPU/memory and the forwarding pattern are meaningful.
